repos_data.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
A terminal workbench in pure Rust: shells, persistent sessions, SSH, coding agents. GPU-rendered on Zed's gpui, VT core from Alacritty.
Fast, open-source, GPU-rendered file manager for macOS. A Finder alternative built in Rust with GPUI.
